Manifest.Name: 垃圾场拾荒地图 / Dumping Ground Map
Manifest.Author: Local
Manifest.Description: 垃圾场分区拾荒、声望成长与拾荒客开局。20/40/100 声望以拾荒客便签介绍客流、搬运及同行服务；100 声望赠信物，解锁 20 信用点的次日同行：多 2 次拾荒，拾荒免受轻伤和重伤。 / Regional scavenging and reputation progression. Scavenger letters introduce rewards at 20/40/100 reputation. At 100, receive a token and unlock a 20-credit next-day outing: 2 extra searches and no scavenging wounds.
